Full summary: Lane 02b (exchange) delivered on lane/02-exchange: Git carrier (exchange ref, verified union, non-interference), C18 fault suite, C17/C22/C24 hardening, C20 deletion, exchange status, chain of trust, ancestor-membership capability; seven live slice defects fixed.
Decisions: [object Object]; [object Object]
Findings: warning: seven live defects existed in the Stage 0 slice and were fixed by lane 02b, the worst being that project() re-read events from disk so a sparse checkout or reset --hard silently dropped admitted records at the next projection (C14 Arm B had passed only because it never re-projected). Journal now caches exact envelope bytes (events.db schema v2). Others: carriers swallowed malformed artifacts; dedup trusted a self-declared digest; cycle detection was per-pass and supersession-only; an imported human principal could mint a ruling signer (C12); nothing bound the signing key to the asserted producer; the deferral trail went stale.; Lane 02b Git topology: orphan refs/heads/twining/exchange built by plumbing (mktree → commit-tree → update-ref → worktree add) at <store>/exchange/; unsupported and stated: shallow-clone exchange worktrees, per-consumer fan-out (C20 per-destination receipts todo), cross-process relay; C18 two-computer topology substituted by two OS processes and declared as such.
